verdict.rationale:
Segment documents a Profile API for agents/programs to query full user/account data (traits, events, external_ids) and a Public API for CRUD on workspace resources (Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans), which supports the 'query customer data via API' half of the story. However, Audience creation is documented as being built from tracking events/traits inside the Engage/Segment app UI, and no evidence shows a documented API or MCP endpoint to create or activate Audiences programmatically — the Public API resource list omits Audiences. No MCP server is documented (the 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor' mentions relate to destination catalog browsing, not an MCP interface for audience creation).
missing for 10: documented API/MCP support for creating and activating Audiences without the dashboard, evidence of an official Segment MCP server, independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end agent workflow.
